claims.content: C2 JU
The C2 JU must be EW-capable and capable of generating and managing track numbers.

The C2 JU must have determined which EW detections are eligible for transmission on the Surveillance Network PG, either manually or through automatic association with predetermined reporting criteria.
An EW-capable C2 JU determines which EW detections are eligible for transmission on the Surveillance Network PG.

trigger.raw_text: An EW-capable C2 JU determines which EW detections are eligible for transmission on the Surveillance Network PG.

claims.content: The C2 JU determines which EW detections are eligible for transmission on the Surveillance Network PG, either manually or through automatic association with predetermined reporting criteria.
The C2 JU reports Line of Bearing (LOB) data derived from sources such as ES, jam strobes, or radio direction finding (RDF) equipment using the J3.7 EW Product Information Message.
The C2 JU sets the Fix or Bearing Descriptor (FIX BRG) field in the J3.7I word to describe the reported LOB.
If additional data is available, the C2 JU adds continuation words to the minimum required word sequences to amplify the EW report.
The C2 JU transmits the J3.7 EW Product Information message containing the surveillance products (LOBs, fixes, and AOPs) on the Surveillance Network PG.

If the C2 JU determines that a track's simulation status needs to be changed (e.g., due to operator error), the track shall be dropped using the J7.0 (ACT = 0) message, and a new track shall be reported.

The one exception to dropping the track for a simulation status change is if the change is from live to simulated and the track is being received from an FJU; in this case, the change shall be accepted without dropping the track.
The J3.7 EW Product Information message containing the reported Electronic Warfare surveillance products (LOBs, fixes, and AOPs) is transmitted on the Surveillance Network PG.
If applicable, LOBs, fixes, and AOPs are amplified by the J6.0 Amplification message on the Surveillance Network PG.
